author: whine-and-cheese
body: Pop’s cafe on 9th and Main in Santa Ana. The original cute Korean couple who ran it for decades bought it back from an entrepreneur who was trying to make a quick buck. They take care of everyone and have a bunch of regulars who show up for breakfast every morning.

author: Agnes327
body: I love this place. They’ve changed the name this time. They still have the Pop’s sign and same menu items, but it’s now June’s
